rows.headline: Majority of Microsoft India employees report salary hikes under 5%
rows.hook: Single-digit raises for most Microsoft India staff
rows.summary: A survey by workplace platform Blind indicates that 91% of Microsoft India employees received salary increases of 5% or less in 2026. The data highlights a trend of constrained compensation growth within the local tech workforce. This development raises questions regarding employee retention and the potential for increased uptake of voluntary buyout programs. Retail investors should note the impact of cost-optimization strategies on the operational overhead of major multinational tech firms in India.
rows.why_it_matters: Signals potential talent churn and cost-cutting at major tech employers.

rows.headline: Operational excellence replaces funding as key startup priority
rows.hook: Operational foundations now critical for startup scaling

This transition reflects a broader market trend where investors prioritize sustainable business models over growth at any cost. Retail investors should note this shift as it impacts the valuation and long-term viability of private companies heading toward IPOs.
